hero.eyebrow: For shops in Thailand with a menu of their own
hero.headline: Your best-selling dish might be losing money on plate after plate
hero.subhead: MenuDesk reads your menu from a photo and shows where the money leaks — which dishes earn, which quietly eat your margin. No stock counts. No spreadsheets.
hero.trustLine: No signup · No card · Takes 2 minutes

problem.title: Most owners know their revenue. Almost none know their margin per dish.
problem.body: Money comes in every day, but nothing tells you whether your most popular plate is earning or bleeding. Ingredient costs drift upward quietly, and you find out at the end of the month when nothing is left.

points.one: Popular dishes with margins thin enough to disappear

step1.title: Photograph your whole menu
step1.body: Open the link, shoot every menu page. No signup, no login.

step2.title: AI reads it and estimates cost
step2.body: We read dish names and the prices already printed on your menu, then estimate ingredient cost from standard recipes and market prices.

step3.title: See which dishes to worry about
step3.body: A green / amber / red ranking, each with a concrete action to take.

honesty.title: We give you a range, not fake precision
honesty.body: The free result is an estimate. We read your real selling prices off the menu, but costs come from standard recipes and market prices, so they can be off by roughly 30–50%. That is why every figure is shown as a range with a confidence level, labelled as an estimate.
honesty.emphasis: Trust the ranking, not the exact baht figure — precise numbers need your real recipes and your real purchase prices.

notInventory.title: This is not an inventory system
notInventory.body: Inventory systems track stuff. MenuDesk tracks money. We will not ask you to count things every day, because nobody keeps that up.

row1.label: Answers
row1.inventory: How much stock do I have?
row1.menudesk: Where is my money leaking, and what do I do?

row3.label: What happens
row3.menudesk: Stays in use because there's almost nothing to do

compatibility.title: Works with any restaurant
compatibility.body: POS or no POS. If you already have a sales system, upload a CSV export for sharper numbers. If you don't, daily totals are enough to start.
compatibility.note: No need to change the system you already use.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Pay when you want real numbers and want it watching for you.

tier2.name: Accurate
tier2.tagline: Real numbers from your real costs
tier2.f1: Cost and margin per dish from your recipes and purchase prices
tier2.f2: Test a price change and see the effect

tier3.name: Watched
tier3.tagline: Stop checking. It tells you on LINE.
tier3.f2: Instant alert when a supplier raises prices

pricing.footnote: Cancel anytime. Prices include tax. Pay by PromptPay or card.

founder.title: Built by people who run a shop
founder.body: MenuDesk started in our own café in Korat. We used it to find our own loss-making dishes before we gave it to anyone else. It isn't software written by people who have never stood behind a counter.

finalCta.title: Want to know which of your dishes lose money?
finalCta.body: Photograph your menu and see the result in two minutes. Free, no signup.
